notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.16 (likely the real fix for the full-screen layout issue):
- Confirmed root cause: Dashboard, Search, and Server Manager were missing .navigationBarHidden(true), so a blank system navigation bar was reserving space above the custom header on every screen -- most noticeable in landscape, where that lost height made the whole interface look squeezed into less than the full screen. Fixed.
- v1.1.15 fix carried forward: nav bar chips no longer cramped in portrait.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
